newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Ciampi sees positive economic trend in '97.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Ciampi sees positive economic trend in '97.

text.p: Italian Treasury Minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi said on Sunday that he expected a positive economic growth trend this year.
"In 1996, we ended the year with no growth, the economy was flat. In 1997 we expect a positive trend," he told reporters at a foreign exchange conference.
"It is not important if growth is more than one percent or a bit less. It is important that the economic trend will be positive," he said.
The government has an official target of two percent growth in 1997 but Labour Minister Tiziano Treu has said the actual figure is more likely to be 1.2-1.5 percent.
